instructions: Read ANTIGRAVITY_BRIDGE.md and docs/REPORT_V2_MULTIPHASE_EVIDENCE_SPEC.md from origin/agent-control.
Verify the exact base SHA 8d87759a6cf39858a2e84f5a7e0e2da992dcc83f and create antigravity/radar-20260923-003 from it.
Do not use Prima for any part of this task.
Replace the current four-phase/four-report patient output with one StudyCase and one combined primary HTML report.
Keep each phase's raw inference results internally, but deduplicate identical findings across phases into a single patient/study-level finding.
Do not average all phase scores. Implement finding/organ phase preferences and select the study-level review score from the best available preferred phase; keep all phase scores expandable.
Use the provided conventional abdominal CT report structure: KỸ THUẬT, MÔ TẢ organ-by-organ, KẾT LUẬN.
Do not auto-generate unsupported definitive normal statements merely from low scores.
Every finding displayed in the prioritized list, MÔ TẢ, or KẾT LUẬN must have an inline evidence image panel directly below/adjacent to it.
Enhance local inference evidence capture so each finding can be associated with the highest-scoring contributing sliding window and phase without storing full model activations.
Within the selected high-scoring window, use the organ segmentation to choose a representative axial slice and generate 1-3 adjacent review images.
If finding-specific window evidence cannot be reliably recovered, use an organ-centered image and visibly label it as an organ-reference fallback; never fabricate lesion localization.
Add R/L markers, phase, slice index, window preset and safe series alias to each evidence image. No PHI may be burned into an image.
Use soft-tissue/lung/bone/calcification display presets as specified, with click-to-enlarge.
Add local-only radiologist review buttons: Phù hợp / Không phù hợp / Chưa chắc, plus print-friendly CSS and Copy reviewed conclusion.
Preserve offline behavior: no CDN, telemetry, remote images, fonts or network calls.
Add synthetic/regression tests for one-study aggregation, deduplication, phase preference, evidence presence, report section structure, PHI-free overlays and offline invariants.
Run the public demo tests first.
After tests pass, re-run or re-render LOCAL_CASE_001 locally using its existing local-only alias. Do not put the real filesystem path or patient identity in GitHub.
For LOCAL_CASE_001, treat the four previously eligible phases as one study and produce exactly one combined primary report.
Keep patient DICOM/NIfTI/CSV/HTML/evidence images outside the Git checkout.

GitHub result may record only aggregate operational data such as phases detected, number of study-level findings displayed, evidence panels generated, runtime, peak VRAM and success/failure. Do not include patient finding names/scores from the real case.
Push code/tests/docs to the working branch and open a new PR. Do not merge existing PRs or the new PR.

acceptance: A new working branch antigravity/radar-20260923-003 exists
Four eligible phases aggregate into one StudyCase and exactly one primary HTML report
Duplicate findings across phases appear once at study level with expandable per-phase scores
Study-level score selection uses explicit phase preferences rather than blind averaging
Report contains KỸ THUẬT, MÔ TẢ and KẾT LUẬN in conventional Vietnamese abdominal CT style
No unsupported definitive normal findings are auto-generated from low model scores
Every displayed prioritized finding has at least one direct review image or an explicit organ-reference fallback
Evidence images include R/L, phase, slice metadata and no PHI
Evidence is described as review aid/model-scored region, never as validated lesion localization
Offline radiologist review controls work locally
LOCAL_CASE_001 is re-rendered locally as one combined multiphase report
No patient-derived data, patient findings, scores, images or report content are pushed to GitHub
A new PR is opened but not merged
